description: This file defines a React functional component 'MultitaskingPrivacy' responsible for managing and displaying multitasking and screenshot privacy settings within a web application's preferences. It utilizes React hooks for state and effect management, interacts with application protection settings, and renders UI elements such as buttons and titles.

methods.name: MultitaskingPrivacy
methods.description: React functional component for privacy settings related to multitasking and screenshots.

methods.name: onScreenshotPrivacyPress
methods.description: Event handler that toggles the screenshot privacy setting when the button is clicked.
